messages:
jordan: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's streaming incident. Need owners for a couple analytic + remediation tasks. TL;DR: partial responses + handshake timeouts spiked ~20:45 UTC; likely backpressure interacting with keepalive window.

maya: I can take the retry-window analysis. Will run traffic sim and produce histograms of observed retransmit intervals. ETA EOD Tue.

sam: I'll own reconnect heuristics design. My rough plan: immediate try + exponential backoff with jitter; add fallback to short-poll after Xms. Want to sync with Maya's sim.

linh: I'll handle alert tuning and add a per-model metric for partial_response_rate so we can SLO that separately. Aim to have alert thresholds and noise reduction by next Wed.

jordan: Cool. Can we also update the Ops runbook? @oncall-alex can you take the runbook + docs test?

oncall-alex: Yep. I'll add checklist entries: `check kv-cache health`, `verify gateway keepalive`, `force-reconnect` procedure, and a quick triage flow. Will take it for a spin Sat during low traffic.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling patch to streaming-proxy v1.9.3 scheduled for 03:00 UTC Sat — canary 5% then 25% if green.

maya: For my sims: adding experiment with 10k concurrent streams and 0.5–1.5s burst windows to reproduce partials. Command I'm using: `scripts/loadtest --streams 10000 --burst 0.5-1.5 --model gamma`

sam: Reconnect sketch: attempts at t=0, 250ms, 500ms, 1s (jitter +-20%), total retry budget 6s, then fallback to short-poll. Also propose a small server-side debounce to avoid duplicate partials (grace-token). Thoughts?

linh: Agree. Also add a feature-flag so Dedicated customers can toggle aggressive reconnect if they'd prefer lower latency over duplicate content risk.

jordan: Action items summary (assignments & timelines):
- maya -> retry-window analysis + sim results (EOD Tue)
- sam -> reconnect design doc + PR with tests (Thu)
- linh -> alert & metric + feature-flag (Wed)
- oncall-alex -> runbook updates + Sat test
- ops-bot -> canary deploy scheduled Sat
I'll own follow-up and share a short status in retro. :thumbsup:

maya: Created tracker issue internal: https://go/retries/issue-482 — put milestones, queries, and sample charts.

sam: Will open PR and tag for review; will include sim harness and unit tests for jitter/backoff.

jordan: Great. If post-canary regressions show up, @oncall-alex please page the streaming pager immediately. Thanks all — closing loop for now.
